lesson.evidence: Crown-12 graph is bipartite (p-nodes vs q-nodes, no internal edges). Greedy coloring with adversarial node order (p1,q1,p2,q2,...) uses 6 colors; bipartite recognition uses optimal 2. Randomized greedy found 2 colors in 11/12 seeds.
lesson.statement: Crown graphs are bipartite; structure recognition beats order-dependent greedy by 3× in color count.

summary: Compared bipartite-exact, greedy-heuristic, 12-seed randomized, and local-search approaches
Bipartite structure yields optimal 2-coloring: p-nodes=0, q-nodes=1
Greedy with bad ordering uses 6 colors; demonstrates importance of structure recognition
All 30 edge constraints verified independently; 12 trials completed
Best valid score: 2 colors (optimal for bipartite graph)
